newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end on high note.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end on high note.

text.p: Shares ended firmer with the strength of European bourses and Wall Street, together with the approach of some key dividend payments, contributing to the optimism.
*Traders said that provided Wall Street remained firm, the Portuguese market could continue positive on Wednesday.
*Portugal Telecom was expected to see good volume again on the final day before it goes ex-dividend. Cement group Cimpor was also boosted by dividend considerations, traders said.
